h1: Kantary Hotel Kabinburi, Prachinburi — a 5-star serviced apartment in central Kabinburi where the all-suite rooms come with a kitchen and a pool
intro: If you need to stay over in Kabinburi — whether you're working in the Prachinburi-side industrial estates, passing along Route 304 toward Khao Yai or Korat, or bringing the family for a long stay and want a roomy unit with a kitchen to cook your own meals, plus a pool and fitness room to unwind after work — Kantary Hotel Kabinburi is the name locals and business travellers mention most · It's a 12-floor hotel and serviced apartment tower in the Cape & Kantary Hotels group, in the heart of Kabinburi district on Suwannason Road, Mueang Kao subdistrict · Rooms are all-suite, from the Studio Suite at 40–44 sqm up to the Two Bedroom Suite, many with a kitchenette and washing machine, plus a pool around 17.5 m long, a jacuzzi, a Matrix-equipped fitness room, a sauna, a steam room, and the California Steak restaurant · Prices start at around THB 2,300/night, with a score of 9.2 from 252 reviews on Trip.com and 4.7/5 on TripAdvisor, ranked #1 in Kabinburi.

body.html: Who Kantary Hotel Kabinburi is for — to put it as briefly as possible, Kantary Kabinburi is a hotel built for "people who have to be in Kabinburi for several days" rather than those who stop for a photo and move on · It isn't a few-hundred-baht roadside guesthouse, nor a hillside resort selling nature views; it's a 5-star hotel and serviced apartment in the Cape & Kantary Hotels group, a 12-floor tower standing in the heart of Kabinburi district on Suwannason Road, Mueang Kao subdistrict · The people it suits best, and who come up most in reviews, are business travellers, engineers and staff coming in to work or train in the industrial estates and factories on the Prachinburi side, plus foreigners on long stays of a week or a month, since the rooms are serviced-apartment style with a kitchenette and washing machine for everyday living · Another good fit is families who want a roomy unit with a sitting area separate from the bed, and travellers driving Route 304 between Bangkok and Korat or Khao Yai who want a decent place to spend the night · Real reviews line up on the strengths: rooms that are spacious and very clean, facilities you'll actually use, and the steady, predictable service standard of a hotel group · On the flip side, if you're after a riverside nature setting or a budget place for a few hundred baht, this may not be the answer, because it's a hotel tower in a small town centre whose selling point is convenience and full facilities, not views or a low price.

Location and getting around — the hotel's address is 349, 349/2 Moo 8, Suwannason Road, Mueang Kao subdistrict, Kabinburi district, Prachinburi province, a location that's quite different from Kantary 304, which sits well inside the industrial-estate zone · The number-one selling point is that it's in the heart of Kabinburi district on Suwannason Road (the main highway), which makes it easier to grab food, hit a convenience store, a market or a petrol station than hotels out in the factory zone · Close by are Kabin Chaloem Rat Park around 1.7 km away and the old-town temples you can stroll to · For longer trips: the building is a well-placed stop on the Bangkok–Korat route, since it's about a 2-hour drive from Bangkok and around 2 hours from Suvarnabhumi Airport as well · Something many people like is that you can drive to the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai in about 30–40 minutes (Khao Yai National Park is around 24–25 km away), so it works well as a base for onward trips · Prachinburi town centre is about 30–40 minutes away, and Kabinburi train station is around 7–8 km out · A fair point that reviews mention: even though it's in the district centre, Kabinburi is a small town, so walking around at night or hailing a taxi may not be as easy as in a big city — having your own car is by far the most convenient, while those who don't drive in can ask about the hotel's airport transfer (extra charge) in advance.

"Came to work near Prachinburi and stayed here for the whole week. The room is as big as an apartment, with a little kitchen and a washing machine in the unit, and after work I could go down for a swim and the gym every day — for a long stay it's a lot more comfortable than your usual single hotel room."

Room types and decor — what sets Kantary Kabinburi apart from an ordinary hotel is that the rooms are all-suite, with none of the cramped standard rooms you get at a typical travel hotel · It starts with the Studio Suite at around 40–44 sqm, which, even as the entry-level room, is big enough to fit a bed, a sofa nook, a dining table and a work desk in one space, with a choice of a King bed or two single beds · Step up to the One Bedroom Suite, which clearly separates the bedroom from the living room, and the largest unit, the Two Bedroom Suite, with two bedrooms plus a living room and kitchen, good for families or groups travelling together · The decor is contemporary in the dark-wood and cream tones that are a Kantary-group signature — understated, warm and not flashy, with lamps and woodwork that feel more like an apartment than a hotel room · The point real reviews praise most consistently is that the rooms are spacious and very clean; many say "the room is bigger than expected for a hotel in a small district town" · Most suite-style rooms come with a kitchenette, an electric/infrared hob, a microwave, a fridge, a washing machine, a bathtub separate from the shower, a flat-screen TV and a work desk, which is great for long stays where you want to cook or do your own laundry · Many rooms have a balcony to sit out and catch the breeze · For people working, the free, stable Wi-Fi and the in-room work desk also earn praise · One expectation to set straight: the building has been open for several years, so some of the decor follows the group's classic style rather than a bold new design, and a few reviews mention the TV feels a touch small for a room this spacious — but you trade that for the space and the good upkeep.

Facilities, pool and fitness — this is another area where Kantary Kabinburi clearly stands apart from other places in the district, because it has big-city-hotel facilities you can actually use, all in one building · The highlight is the outdoor pool around 17.5 m long on a mezzanine level, with sun loungers and poolside umbrellas, a quiet and easy evening atmosphere and not many people, perfect for a swim after work · Several reviews praise the pool as attractive and uncrowded, especially in the evening when the underwater lights are on · Next is the jacuzzi (open in the evenings), the sauna and the steam room for easing tired muscles · The fitness room earns special praise because the equipment is Matrix-brand and in good shape, with a treadmill and several weight machines and a city view through large windows — something you don't often find in an upcountry district-level hotel · There's also an Executive Lounge for premium-room guests, plus meeting and banquet rooms in several sizes that handle company events and training, free parking, a service counter, a left-luggage service, and free Wi-Fi throughout · To be honest, with a location in a small district the hotel's own facilities matter a lot, because most guests spend their post-work time within the hotel grounds rather than heading out, and on this front Kantary Kabinburi does well enough that it's the main reason people come back to stay again.

Food and dining — the hotel's main restaurants are the California Steak Restaurant and Kantary Kitchen, a shared signature of the Cape & Kantary group · They serve Thai, Western and steak dishes from midday into the evening in a relaxed setting · The food point real reviews praise most is the buffet breakfast, with plenty of variety across Thai and Western dishes, including hot soups, meats, vegetables and fresh fruit, open around 6:00 AM–10:00 AM; many say it's a better breakfast than expected for a hotel in a small district town · For guests in a suite with a kitchenette, having convenience stores, a market and roadside restaurants near Suwannason Road makes it easy to buy ingredients and cook your own meals — the charm of a serviced-apartment stay, and what keeps a long stay of several days from getting dull or running up too much of a dining-out bill · A few reviews offer small suggestions for breakfast, such as wanting a decaf coffee option added, more a minor nitpick than a problem · Overall, the food is a strength that makes a stay in Kabinburi convenient and complete in one place.

Service — service is an area that earns steady praise in real reviews, reflecting the Cape & Kantary group's systematic approach to looking after its staff and service · Several front-desk and service staff are mentioned in reviews as friendly, smiling and helpful beyond the call; one review says the staff "went out of their way to help guests" and gave good advice on getting around or where to eat · The service long-stay guests value is the consistent room cleaning, the laundry handling (on top of the in-room washing machine) and a reachable counter · An airport transfer is available for an extra charge, which helps those who don't drive in · To be straight about it, the service and room points raised are small things — some rooms' air-conditioning is a bit loud at times, plus minor breakfast details — rather than problems with the people or the core service · Overall, service is a strength and a reason corporate clients and regular guests come back.

What real reviews say (praise and gripes) — gathered from Trip.com, Agoda, Booking.com and TripAdvisor, and the picture comes out fairly consistent · On the praise side: rooms spacious and very clean, all-suite rooms with a kitchenette and washing machine good for long stays, the 17.5 m pool attractive and uncrowded, the jacuzzi, Matrix fitness, sauna and steam room complete and in good shape, a varied buffet breakfast with fresh ingredients, friendly and helpful staff, and value for money that many single out as a strength · On Booking.com it scores around 8.8 and on TripAdvisor around 4.7 out of 5, ranked #1 of 2 hotels in Kabinburi district, while Trip.com sits at around 9.2 from 252 reviews · On the gripes side: the things mentioned are small points rather than big problems — some reviews say the air-conditioning in certain rooms is a bit loud, next is the TV being a touch small for a room this spacious, a wish for a decaf coffee option at breakfast, and a few times when equipment or the pool's opening status could be made clearer · On top of that, the building has been open for several years, so some of the decor is the group's classic style rather than a new design · These gripes are things you can manage by choosing the right room and setting expectations, rather than problems that keep people from coming back.

"The room was clean and very spacious, the staff smiley and helpful, the breakfast had plenty to choose from, the Matrix gym equipment was better than expected, and the pool was lovely and not crowded · The only gripe is the air-conditioning being a bit loud at night; everything else is great value."

Price and value — the starting price is around THB 2,300/night for a Studio Suite at normal rates, rising to around THB 2,800–3,500+ for the larger One Bedroom Suite, or during periods when the hotel fills up from local events · The Two Bedroom Suite sits in a higher price band based on size and number of guests · Compared with other places in Kabinburi and Prachinburi, it helps to understand that Kantary Kabinburi plays in a different market from a few-hundred-baht roadside guesthouse like The Resort Kabinburi or a hillside resort selling atmosphere · What makes it good value is that this price gets you a spacious all-suite room with a kitchenette and washing machine, plus a pool, jacuzzi, fitness, sauna, steam room and a buffet breakfast, at the steady, predictable standard of a 5-star hotel group, for a price that's several times cheaper than a hotel of the same level in a big city · For people on a long stay of a week or a month for local work, having your own kitchen to cook, a washing machine and full facilities all in one place saves both on dining out and on travel time, which makes it very good value per night among the province's accommodation at this level · If you're planning a long stay, it's worth asking about the monthly (long-stay) rate, which is usually clearly better than booking by the night.

Good to know before booking — a few things help a stay go more smoothly · One: if you're staying long or coming as a group, choose a suite-style room with a kitchenette and washing machine; it's better value than a small room because you can cook and do laundry yourself, with a separate sitting area · Two: ask about the monthly (long-stay) rate if you'll be staying several weeks for local work — it's usually better than booking by the night · Three: if you're a light sleeper sensitive to noise, ask for a room with quiet air-conditioning or try to switch rooms, since some reviews mention the air-conditioning in certain rooms · Four: during big training events or company functions in the Prachinburi area, rooms fill up fast and prices rise, so book ahead and compare several platforms · Five: make the most of the hotel facilities — the pool, jacuzzi, fitness, sauna and steam room — and ask clearly about the opening and closing times for the pool and jacuzzi · Six: if you're not driving in, ask about the hotel's airport transfer (extra charge) in advance · Check-in is at 2:00 PM, check-out at 12:00 PM.

Summary — from all the real reviews, Kantary Hotel Kabinburi, Prachinburi, is the best fit for people who have to be in Kabinburi for several days to work in the Prachinburi area, families who want a roomy unit with a kitchen, travellers driving Route 304, and those using it as a base for the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai · Spacious, clean all-suite rooms with a kitchenette and washing machine, full facilities including a 17.5 m pool, jacuzzi, Matrix fitness, sauna, steam room, Executive Lounge, a praised buffet breakfast, and the Cape & Kantary group service standard make it good value and predictable — earning a score of 9.2 from 252 reviews on Trip.com and 4.7 out of 5 on TripAdvisor, ranked #1 in Kabinburi district · If you're looking for a riverside nature setting, a hillside resort or a budget place for a few hundred baht, this may not be the answer, and you should consider a hillside resort on the Noen Hom side or a light-on-the-wallet roadside place instead · But for a stay that wants convenience, cleanliness and full facilities in one building in central Kabinburi — Kantary Kabinburi is a choice that meets that need almost completely, and it's the reason regular guests and corporate clients keep coming back.

honestSummary: Kantary Hotel Kabinburi is the choice that fits best for people who have to be in Kabinburi for several days to work in the Prachinburi area, families who want a roomy unit with a kitchen, and those driving Route 304 or using it as a base for the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai — a 5-star, 12-floor Cape & Kantary serviced apartment where the all-suite rooms are spacious and clean, with a kitchen and washing machine, and full facilities including a 17.5 m pool, jacuzzi, Matrix fitness, sauna and a praised buffet breakfast · The trade-off is that it's a hotel tower in a small district centre, not a nature-view resort, with the group's classic decor style rather than a new design.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Kantary Hotel Kabinburi, Prachinburi

faq.q: Where is Kantary Hotel Kabinburi, and is it easy to get to?
faq.a: The hotel is at 349, 349/2 Moo 8, Suwannason Road, Mueang Kao subdistrict, Kabinburi district, Prachinburi province, in the heart of Kabinburi district on Suwannason Road · It's easy to grab food and reach a convenience store · It's about a 2-hour drive from Bangkok and Suvarnabhumi Airport, near Kabin Chaloem Rat Park around 1.7 km away, and you can drive to the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai in about 30–40 minutes · It's a small town, so having your own car is by far the most convenient.

faq.q: What's the starting price at Kantary Hotel Kabinburi, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around THB 2,300/night for a Studio Suite at normal rates · Rooms are all-suite, with a Studio Suite (40–44 sqm), One Bedroom Suite and Two Bedroom Suite · Many suite-style rooms have a kitchenette and washing machine, good for long stays · Prices rise during local events, so compare several platforms before booking, and for a long stay ask about the monthly rate.

faq.q: What are the rooms at Kantary Hotel Kabinburi like, and is there a kitchen?
faq.a: The rooms are all-suite, spacious and clean, decorated in the dark-wood and cream tones of the Kantary group · Most suite-style rooms come with a kitchenette, an electric/infrared hob, a microwave, a fridge, a washing machine, a bathtub separate from the shower, a work desk and a flat-screen TV · Real reviews agree the rooms are bigger than expected and very clean, good for people on long stays who want to cook or do their own laundry.

faq.q: Does Kantary Hotel Kabinburi have a pool and fitness room?
faq.a: Yes, both · An outdoor pool around 17.5 m long, a jacuzzi, a fitness room with Matrix equipment in good shape, a sauna and a steam room are open to guests · There's an Executive Lounge, the California Steak / Kantary Kitchen restaurant serving Thai–Western–steak dishes, and a buffet breakfast praised for its variety.

faq.q: Who is Kantary Hotel Kabinburi for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for business travellers and people working in the Prachinburi area, families who want a roomy unit with a kitchen, travellers driving Route 304, and those using it as a base for the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai · It's a 5-star serviced apartment focused on spacious all-suite rooms, full facilities and the Cape & Kantary group service standard · But if you're looking for a riverside nature setting, a hillside resort or a budget place for a few hundred baht, a hillside resort or a roadside place may suit you better.

faq.q: What's the difference between Kantary Hotel Kabinburi and Kantary 304 Hotel?
faq.a: Both are in the Cape & Kantary Hotels group but in different locations · Kantary Hotel Kabinburi is a 12-floor tower in the heart of Kabinburi district on Suwannason Road, good for people working or passing through the Kabinburi side who want to be near the small town centre · Kantary 304 Hotel is in Tha Tum subdistrict, Si Maha Phot district, about 15 minutes from the 304 Industrial Park, good for people working directly in the 304 estate · Both are all-suite with a kitchen and similar full facilities — choose based on which side your business is on.
